# 数据检查（本周自动发现）

本页对 `weeks/`r params$week`/data/` 下所有 CSV 自动执行三件事：

1. **质量检查（tidy-data-inspector）**：7 步确定性检查——结构、缺失与重复、低基数、高基数数值/日期/字符串、相关性告警。
2. **清洗审计（data-cleaning）**：先审计后清洗、原始不可覆盖——空白文本归一为 `NA`、剥离全空行与完全重复行、数值列加 `*_outlier_flag`，清洗结果写入 `output/<name>_cleaned.csv` 并附结构化日志。
3. **整洁演示（tidy-data）**：把各数据集的字段元数据合并为一张长表，演示按组汇总与长宽重塑。

本周目录：`r params$week`（自动发现该周 `data/` 下所有 CSV 并逐个检查）。

本报告仅陈述事实，不含"好 / 坏"判断。

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
})

# 路径解析：用项目根标记 assets/ 定位根目录（兼容工作目录 / 临时文件名差异），
# 周目录由 params$week 决定（每个周文件单独设定）
find_root <- function() {
  starts <- unique(c(getwd(), dirname(knitr::current_input())))
  for (s in starts) {
    cur <- normalizePath(s, mustWork = FALSE)
    for (i in seq_len(10)) {
      if (dir.exists(file.path(cur, "assets"))) return(cur)
      cur <- dirname(cur)
    }
  }
  stop("未找到项目根目录（含 assets 目录）")
}

root <- find_root()
week <- params$week
data_dir <- file.path(root, "weeks", week, "data")
out_dir <- file.path(root, "weeks", week, "output")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

csv_files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(csv_files) == 0) {
  cat("WARNING: 未在", data_dir, "找到任何 CSV 文件\n")
}

low_card_threshold <- 20
corr_threshold <- 0.99

week_summary <- tibble(
  dataset = character(),
  rows = integer(),
  cols = integer(),
  missing_cells = integer(),
  dup_rows = integer()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: inspect-and-clean
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

for (f in csv_files) {
  ds_name <- sub("\\.csv$", "", basename(f))
  df <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
  n_total <- nrow(df)

  cat(sprintf("\n## 数据集：%s\n\n", ds_name))
  cat(sprintf("**维度**：%d 行 × %d 列\n\n", nrow(df), ncol(df)))

  col_info <- tibble(
    name = names(df),
    type = map_chr(df, \(x) if (inherits(x, "Date") || inherits(x, "POSIXct")) "datetime" else if (is.numeric(x)) "numeric" else "string"),
    n_unique = map_int(df, \(x) length(unique(x))),
    n_missing = map_int(df, \(x) sum(is.na(x)))
  ) |>
    mutate(missing_pct = n_missing / n_total)

  # ---- 1. Skeleton ----
  cat("### 1. Skeleton\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(
    col_info |> mutate(missing_pct = sprintf("%.2f%%", missing_pct * 100)),
    format = "html", escape = TRUE))
  cat("\n")

  # ---- 2. Missing and duplicates ----
  cat("### 2. Missing and duplicates\n\n")
  miss <- col_info |> filter(n_missing > 0) |> arrange(desc(missing_pct))
  if (nrow(miss) > 0) {
    print(knitr::kable(
      miss |> select(name, type, n_missing, missing_pct) |>
        mutate(missing_pct = sprintf("%.2f%%", missing_pct * 100)),
      format = "html", escape = TRUE))
  } else {
    cat("**无缺失值。**\n\n")
  }
  n_dup <- sum(duplicated(df))
  cat(sprintf("**完全重复行数：%d**\n\n", n_dup))

  # ---- 3. Low-cardinality ----
  cat(sprintf("### 3. Low-cardinality (unique <= %d)\n\n", low_card_threshold))
  low <- col_info |> filter(n_unique <= low_card_threshold)
  if (nrow(low) > 0) {
    freq <- map_dfr(low$name, \(col) {
      df |>
        count(.data[[col]]) |>
        rename(value = all_of(col)) |>
        mutate(column = col, value = as.character(value), prop = n / n_total) |>
        select(column, value, n, prop)
    }) |> arrange(column, desc(n))
    print(knitr::kable(
      freq |> mutate(prop = sprintf("%.2f%%", prop * 100)),
      format = "html", escape = TRUE))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("**无低基数列（unique <= %d）。**\n\n", low_card_threshold))
  }

  # ---- 4. High-cardinality numeric ----
  cat(sprintf("### 4. High-cardinality numeric (> %d)\n\n", low_card_threshold))
  num_cols <- col_info |> filter(type == "numeric", n_unique > low_card_threshold) |> pull(name)
  if (length(num_cols) > 0) {
    num_stats <- map_dfr(num_cols, \(col) {
      v <- df[[col]]
      q <- quantile(v, c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)
      iqr <- q[3] - q[1]
      lo <- q[1] - 1.5 * iqr
      hi <- q[3] + 1.5 * iqr
      n_nm <- sum(!is.na(v))
      tibble(
        column = col, min = min(v, na.rm = TRUE), max = max(v, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean = mean(v, na.rm = TRUE), median = q[2], sd = sd(v, na.rm = TRUE),
        q1 = q[1], q3 = q[3], n_negative = sum(v < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_zero = sum(v == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        outlier_pct = sum(v < lo | v > hi, na.rm = TRUE) / n_nm
      )
    })
    print(knitr::kable(
      num_stats |> mutate(
        across(c(min, max, mean, median, sd, q1, q3), \(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)),
        outlier_pct = sprintf("%.2f%%", outlier_pct * 100)),
      format = "html", escape = TRUE))
  } else {
    cat("**无高基数数值列。**\n\n")
  }

  # ---- 5. High-cardinality datetime ----
  cat(sprintf("### 5. High-cardinality datetime (> %d)\n\n", low_card_threshold))
  dt_cols <- col_info |> filter(type == "datetime", n_unique > low_card_threshold) |> pull(name)
  if (length(dt_cols) > 0) {
    dt_stats <- map_dfr(dt_cols, \(col) {
      v <- df[[col]] |> as.Date()
      tibble(
        column = col, earliest = min(v, na.rm = TRUE), latest = max(v, na.rm = TRUE),
        span_days = as.integer(max(v, na.rm = TRUE) - min(v, na.rm = TRUE)),
        n_missing = sum(is.na(v)))
    })
    print(knitr::kable(dt_stats, format = "html", escape = TRUE))
  } else {
    cat("**无高基数日期列。**\n\n")
  }

  # ---- 6. High-cardinality string ----
  cat(sprintf("### 6. High-cardinality string (> %d)\n\n", low_card_threshold))
  str_cols <- col_info |> filter(type == "string", n_unique > low_card_threshold) |> pull(name)
  if (length(str_cols) > 0) {
    str_stats <- map_dfr(str_cols, \(col) {
      v <- df[[col]]
      vc <- v[!is.na(v)]
      mode_val <- names(sort(table(vc), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
      tibble(
        column = col,
        min_len = min(str_length(vc)), max_len = max(str_length(vc)),
        n_empty = sum(vc == ""),
        n_ws_only = sum(str_trim(vc) == "" & vc != ""),
        mode = mode_val,
        mode_pct = sum(vc == mode_val, na.rm = TRUE) / length(vc))
    })
    print(knitr::kable(
      str_stats |> mutate(mode_pct = sprintf("%.2f%%", mode_pct * 100)),
      format = "html", escape = TRUE))
  } else {
    cat("**无高基数字符串列。**\n\n")
  }

  # ---- 7. Correlation alerts ----
  cat(sprintf("### 7. Correlation alerts (|r| > %s)\n\n", corr_threshold))
  num_df <- df |> select(where(is.numeric))
  if (ncol(num_df) >= 2) {
    corr <- cor(num_df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    idx <- which(abs(corr) > corr_threshold & corr < 1, arr.ind = TRUE)
    idx <- idx[idx[, 1] < idx[, 2], , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(idx) > 0) {
      pairs <- tibble(
        var1 = rownames(corr)[idx[, 1]], var2 = colnames(corr)[idx[, 2]],
        corr = corr[idx]) |>
        arrange(desc(abs(corr)))
      print(knitr::kable(
        pairs |> mutate(corr = sprintf("%.3f", corr)),
        format = "html", escape = TRUE))
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("**无 |r| > %s 的列对。**\n\n", corr_threshold))
    }
  } else {
    cat("**数值列不足 2 列，跳过相关性检查。**\n\n")
  }

  # ---- 8. 清洗审计与处理（data-cleaning）----
  cat("### 8. 清洗审计与处理（data-cleaning）\n\n")
  df_c <- df |> mutate(across(where(is.character), \(x) na_if(str_trim(x), "")))
  empty_flag <- df_c |>
    mutate(across(everything(), is.na)) |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(.empty = all(c_across(everything()), na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    pull(.empty)
  n_empty <- sum(empty_flag)
  df_c <- df_c |> filter(!empty_flag)
  n_dup2 <- sum(duplicated(df_c))
  df_c <- df_c |> distinct()
  flag_cols <- col_info |> filter(type == "numeric") |> pull(name)
  if (length(flag_cols) > 0) {
    df_c <- df_c |> mutate(across(all_of(flag_cols), \(x) {
      q <- quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)
      iqr <- q[2] - q[1]
      (x < q[1] - 1.5 * iqr) | (x > q[2] + 1.5 * iqr)
    }, .names = "{.col}_outlier_flag"))
  }
  clean_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(ds_name, "_cleaned.csv"))
  write_csv(df_c, clean_path)

  log_tbl <- tibble(
    step = c("空白文本→NA", "全空行剔除", "完全重复行剔除", "数值列异常值标记"),
    rule = c("字符列 trim 后空串转 NA", "所有字段为空/NA 的行删除",
             "duplicated() 全重复行删除", "IQR 法新增 *_outlier_flag（不删行）"),
    affected = c("-", n_empty, n_dup2, length(flag_cols)),
    decision = c("默认处理", "默认处理（低风险）", "默认处理（低风险）", "仅标记不删除"))
  print(knitr::kable(log_tbl, format = "html", escape = TRUE))
  cat(sprintf("\n清洗结果已写入 `%s`（%d 行 × %d 列，原始 `%s` 未覆盖）。\n\n",
              clean_path, nrow(df_c), ncol(df_c), f))

  week_summary <- bind_rows(week_summary, tibble(
    dataset = ds_name, rows = n_total, cols = ncol(df),
    missing_cells = sum(col_info$n_missing), dup_rows = n_dup))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: week-summary
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
cat("## 周级整洁汇总（tidy-data）\n\n")
print(knitr::kable(week_summary, format = "html", escape = TRUE))

cat("\n### 字段元数据长表 → 各类型计数宽表\n\n")
all_meta <- map_dfr(csv_files, \(f) {
  ds <- sub("\\.csv$", "", basename(f))
  d <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
  tibble(
    dataset = ds, column = names(d),
    type = map_chr(d, \(x) if (is.numeric(x)) "numeric"
                    else if (inherits(x, "Date") || inherits(x, "POSIXct")) "datetime"
                    else "string"))
})
type_wide <- all_meta |>
  count(dataset, type) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
print(knitr::kable(type_wide, format = "html", escape = TRUE))
```
